nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes:
Edit segment_name to target a different segment.
test_mode=true: all sends go to test_recipient_email.
shadow_mode=true: AI service runs but no email is sent (logs only).

parameters.query:
SELECT us.user_id, us.email, us.segment_name, au.name AS user_name, au.country AS user_country
FROM user_segments us
INNER JOIN auth_user au ON au.id = us.user_id
WHERE us.segment_name = '{{ $json.segment_name }}'
  AND (us.campaign_last_sent_at IS NULL
       OR us.campaign_last_sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $json.cooldown_days }} days')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM user_segments us2
      WHERE us2.user_id = us.user_id
        AND us2.campaign_last_sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $json.throttle_hours }} hours'
  );
